title: Manifest IDs were interpolated as executable registry keys

reproduction.manifestId: A non-empty ID accepted by ResourceManifestSchema containing a quote followed by a TypeScript expression.
reproduction.beforeFix: generateGoldRendererRegistry and generatePreviewsRegistry emitted the expression outside the quoted key, producing executable TypeScript syntax.
reproduction.afterFix: Both registries emit the complete ID as a JSON-encoded string key.

rootCause: Generated source wrapped manifest IDs and resource slugs in single quotes using raw string interpolation.
remediation: Serialize import paths, IDs, and slugs as JSON string literals; validate slugs and generated component identifiers before emitting code.

verification.redBeforeFix: The generated-metadata test failed because the expected JSON-encoded key was absent; the output contained a throw expression as TypeScript syntax.
verification.command: pnpm exec vitest run tests/security/gold-artifacts.test.ts -t "serializes validated manifest IDs"
